title: Temple of Vines
intro: Deep in the jungle, a ruined temple has lost its idol. Return it to the altar to wake the temple.
win_epilogue: Sunlight floods the temple, and a hidden path opens through the jungle toward home.

temple_steps.name: Temple Steps
temple_steps.description: Vines choke the crumbling steps. A stone altar sits beside a mossy statue. The inner chamber is north.
temple_steps.sounds: Insects buzz, and far away something large crashes through the trees.

inner_chamber.name: Inner Chamber
inner_chamber.description: Roots crack the walls around a vine-wrapped urn. A scarlet parrot watches from a ledge. The temple steps are south.
inner_chamber.sounds: Water drips somewhere in the dark.

machete.name: machete
machete.description: A notched machete, still sharp enough to cut vines.

stone_altar.name: stone altar
stone_altar.description: The altar is bare. A hollow in its top is the shape of a small idol.

clay_urn.name: clay urn
clay_urn.description: A clay urn bound tight in thick vines.
clay_urn.alt_description: The urn sits open, cut vines curled around its base.

jade_idol.name: jade idol
jade_idol.description: A small green idol with a grinning face, smooth from many hands.

scarlet_parrot.name: scarlet parrot
scarlet_parrot.description: A scarlet parrot with one clever black eye.

dialogue.text: 'Vines! Vines!' the parrot squawks. 'Machete on the steps! Machete on the steps!'
The parrot bobs its head from the idol toward the altar outside.

interactions.message: You hack through the vines. The lid slides off, and a jade idol rolls out onto the floor.
You set the idol in the hollow. Stone grinds on stone, and the whole temple shakes awake.
